title: Dead Reckoning
description: Live tracking is only useful if the dashboard notices when its WebSocket connection drops and reconnects on its own, instead of silently going stale (FR-804). Enable connection flakiness on the tracking module and confirm the dashboard surfaces the drop and recovers.
successCondition: With FLAKE_FAILURE_RATE_TRACKING set high enough to force a drop, the tracking dashboard UI visibly indicates a disconnected/reconnecting state (not just a silent console error) and, once reconnected, resumes receiving live shipment updates without requiring a manual page reload.
hints: FLAKE_FAILURE_RATE_TRACKING is an environment variable on the API — see docs/self-host.md for how flakiness injection works.
The reconnect indicator should be an actual visible UI element (banner/toast/status text), per the project's rule that flaky states must never be console-only.
